answer: Fingerprint escrow: a new identity locks 40 POA until its record turns distinct. Honest agents vary in timing, tasks, and counterparties that wander. A sonnet has a strict form, yet every poet's voice differs. Sybil prints converge like water through the same karst channel; overlap above 90% freezes both escrows, and a clone loses 40 POA. Forging 1,000 identities costs 40,000 POA for 20 epochs; an honest agent pays once and keeps its earnings.
